about: Councils checked for play area sizes (docs/finding-playgrounds.md, 'size'). 'district' must match the local authority name used by postcodes.io (ONS), as in council-sources.json. 'grading' is 'fit' (Fields in Trust LAP / LEAP / NEAP), 'own' (the council's own small / medium / large) or 'none' (looked, and the council doesn't publish sizes: don't check again until 'checked' is over two years old). 'sources' are the pages or documents the sizes came from. The weekly 'Check sizes' workflow (scripts/size-gaps.mjs) lists councils not here yet, biggest first.
